nodes.name: Web chat apps can now connect to NullDull. Add…
nodes.text: Web chat apps can now connect to NullDull. Add `https://nulldull.com/mcp` as a custom connector in an app that supports remote MCP servers, such as ChatGPT or Claude, and sign in when the app asks. You approve the connection on the same NullDull page as an agent on your computer, and you can revoke it any time in Settings → Your agent connections.

nodes.name: What a web chat connection can do.
nodes.text: ## What a web chat connection can do.

nodes.name: It reads and works in your workspace through the same…
nodes.text: It reads and works in your workspace through the same tools and permission checks as the NullDull CLI: Memory, and Tasks, Locale and Grid when you allow them. It starts from Memory “Read and propose changes” with everything else off, whatever the app asks for. Web chat connections never get Secrets access and cannot read or write files on your computer; for repositories, Secrets and large translation imports, use the CLI.

nodes.name: Some apps keep their list of tools from when they first…
nodes.text: Some apps keep their list of tools from when they first connected. After you change a connection’s permissions, use the app’s option to refresh its tools.

nodes.name: One question to connect an agent.
nodes.text: ## One question to connect an agent.

nodes.name: Agents that connect through the CLI now ask first: should…
nodes.text: Agents that connect through the CLI now ask first: should they get full access, editing Memory, Locale, Tasks and Grid and creating products and projects? Say yes and the approval page opens with those choices filled in, so connecting is one click. Say no and the agent asks what you want for each product. Secrets are never part of full access, and you can change every choice before you approve. This needs client 0.19.0.

nodes.name: Locale and Tasks in early access.
nodes.text: ## Locale and Tasks in early access.

nodes.name: Locale, for translation, and Tasks, for work shared by…
nodes.text: Locale, for translation, and Tasks, for work shared by people and agents, are part of early access. Each needs its own permission on an agent connection, off by default.
